purpose: Evaluate the complete MathCheck Skill workflow from natural-language input through parsing, task construction, backend search or candidate verification, optional reduction, re-verification, and final reporting.
relationship_to_backend_benchmark: This is a Skill-level E2E set. It complements, and does not replace, the existing 60-task MathCheck-Bench backend suite.

evaluation_protocol.execution_unit: Each case is one fresh Skill interaction. Preserve the natural-language user_input exactly; inject fixtures.candidate_graph when present.
evaluation_protocol.task_comparison: Compare normalized_task semantic fields; property_id may vary, but premises, conclusion, graph_type, range, search_mode, seed, and max_graphs must match.
evaluation_protocol.witness_comparison: Do not require byte-identical edges. A returned witness passes if it is structurally valid, in scope, satisfies every premise, and falsifies the conclusion.
evaluation_protocol.no_counterexample_comparison: For exhaustive tasks, require completion and correct scope. For random/special tasks, require honest coverage disclosure; do not treat a miss as a proof.
evaluation_protocol.clarification_comparison: Require a targeted clarification and no backend call before the semantic ambiguity is resolved.
evaluation_protocol.unsupported_comparison: Require explicit unsupported status and a precise unsupported feature; no silent semantic approximation.
evaluation_protocol.repeat_policy: Run deterministic/exhaustive cases once per model-version; run random-search cases at least 3 times with their fixed seed and verify identical backend sampling behavior when supported.
